В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: Evolve
programme.desc: Throughout the eons of its existence, the natural world has played host to this never-ending competition called life. Since the dawn of time, roughly 99 percent of all species have become extinct. In order to survive, all creatures, including man, must treat life as a battlefield and master the natural weapons and defenses that they have evolved: Tyrannosaurus Rex's 13-inch canines; the Gecko's velcro-like toe pads; the Bald Eagle's telescopic vision capable of spotting a hare a mile away. How did these attributes, each unique to the organism itself, appear? Certainly not arbitrarily. They evolved for a common reason - to give these animals a critical edge in inter-species warfare, and to ensure the survival of the individual's genes into the next generation. To evolve is to survive!

programme.title: Engineering Disasters
programme.desc: This episode investigates a stage collapse at the Indiana State Fair that leaves seven concertgoers dead. Is a gas leak to blame for an explosion in New York City that levels two buildings and kills eight people in their homes? Disaster strikes on an airliner at 36,000 feet as a gaping hole suddenly rips open midflight. Engineers in Japan scramble to save the lives of millions as an epic radioactive release looms. And, how could a train crossing be the site of not one, but two disastrous auto collisions in a single year?

programme.title: Ancient Top 10
programme.desc: Ancient Top 10 is smart, fun countdown that details how ancient technology worked, how surprisingly advanced it was, and how it was kind of awesome. Location shooting, CGI, and graphics are pulled from past History series Ancient Impossible and Ancient Discoveries, and lists are organized by themes. The stories are augmented by new entries fueled by the History archive. Episodes include updated "Top Ten" graphics and new interviews that provide "wow" facts and explain why something made the list. The lists will have organizing principles so it doesn't seem arbitrary. Episodes could include the following: Top 10 Secrets of Egypt, Top 10 Ancient Vikings, Top 10 Greek Inventions, Top 10 Ancient Weapons, Top 10 Ancient Monuments, Top 10 Ancient Ships, Top 10 Torture Devices, Top 10 Roman Inventions, Top 10 Ancient Swords, and Top 10 Ancient Sieges.

programme.title: Life After People
programme.desc: This unique documentary series explores what the planet would look like if all human life diappeared. With comment and opinion coming from scientists, engineers and other experts, this show speculates on how a lack of human intervention would impact on the environment and the other animal species. The show does not provide any explanation as to why humans have vanished from the face of the Earth but does surmise that human infrastructure is still present along with pets and domesticated livestock. Each episode explores what would happen to specific structures such as skyscrapers, bridges and dams or details the impact on human remains, artefacts and other objects. Some real-life abandoned locations are discussed and the show also uses CGI dramatisations to depict how the situation would look after one day, one week, one year, 10 years, 15 years, 25 years, 50 years, 100 years, 200 years, etc.

programme.title: Brad Meltzer's Lost History
programme.desc: Host Brad Meltzer enlists America's help to find lost and stolen historical artifacts, which are going missing from museums and public collections at an alarming rate. The most shocking missing item of all: the iconic Ground Zero Flag, raised by firefighters on 9/11. A few hours after it was raised, this sacred relic simply disappeared. Then, a multi-million dollar collection of jewel-encrusted swords and daggers that once belonged to Harry Truman is stolen, in a daring daylight heist. Plus: the incredible story of John Dillinger's Tommy gun, stolen from a police station before becoming his favorite weapon, goes missing for decades.

programme.title: The Hunt for Baltic Gold
programme.desc: Amber has been coveted in Poland since the 15th century, when handmade jewellery incorporating this semi-precious stone (even though it is not a 'stone') was sought after by members of the Royal, Imperial, Papal and Ottoman Courts. With 70% of the world's amber being produced in Poland, the industry is still thriving, especially in the coastal areas around the port city of Gdansk. The viewer will learn about the journey of amber, from its origins as fossilized tree resin to its extraction from the ground and its transfromation into creative and beautiful decorations. The show also tells the story of the people who work in the industry and the difficulties they face in harvesting the amber, getting it to market and selling it.

programme.title: Lost Worlds
programme.desc: Documentary series that brings back to life lost cities, structures, cultures, and civilisations, transporting viewers back in time and revealing the truth behind some of history's most iconic eras. Using a combination of cutting-edge technology and archaeological research, the team detail what life was like for these places during their peak of their powers, and use visual overlays to compare past and present landscapes. From the Knights Templar to the lost city of Atlantis, ancient Egypt to Hitler's planned supercity, and ancient Athens to America's wild west, each episodes dives into these extraordinary remnants of human history.

programme.title: Cities of the Underworld
programme.desc: In major cities around the world today, skyscrapers loom overhead, taxis honk their horns and street vendors peddle their wares. But below lies city upon city - each with its fascinating and unknown history. This series will explore these layers, which are often hundreds of feet deep, and examine a city's ancient cisterns, dank dungeons, eerie tombs, clandestine hideouts, and even underground shipwrecks that have been lost for hundreds and hundreds of years. What are the underground layers of the most populated cities on earth? And how did (and do) engineers build layer upon layer up to today's city streets? This series will reveal the technological marvels that allowed the construction of one city upon another - literally.

programme.desc: Host Brad Meltzer enlists America's help to find lost and stolen historical artifacts, which are going missing from museums and public collections at an alarming rate. The most shocking missing item of all: the iconic Ground Zero Flag, raised by firefighters on 9/11. A few hours after it was raised, this sacred relic simply disappeared. Then, a multi-million dollar collection of jewel-encrusted swords and daggers that once belonged to Harry Truman is stolen, in a daring daylight heist. Plus: the incredible story of John Dillinger's Tommy gun, stolen from a police station before becoming his favorite weapon, goes missing for decades.

programme.title: Hunting Hitler
programme.desc: An FBI cold case that has laid dormant for 70 years leads a group of world-renown investigators on the ultimate manhunt to finally answer the question: Did Adolf Hitler survive World War II? In early 2014 the FBI declassified hundreds of confidential documents showing that Hitler may have not committed suicide but rather escaped to South America after the fall of Germany. A memo from J. Edgar Hoover himself states "American Army officials in Germany have not located Hitler's body nor is there any reliable source that will say definitely that Hitler is dead." Armed with the most cutting edge technology and these newly released FBI files the team will approach this case like a modern death claims investigation. Whether they are investigating a mysterious Nazi lair deep in the Argentinian jungle or diving for evidence of a missing U-Boat that could of shuttled Hitler to South America our team will focus on the tried and tested tenants for solving a fraudulent death case: follow the money where was the subject last seen, eyewitness reports, make contact with known associates and forensics.With declassified worldwide intelligence providing a wealth of new clues and modern technology never before available we reopen this world famous cold case in hopes of solving the mystery surrounding the demise of one of the biggest criminals of all time.

programme.title: Engineering an Empire
programme.desc: In an era long passed, mighty empires were forged from nothing and rose to the heights of power. Join host Peter Weller, an actor and a professor at Syracuse University as he travels the world to show the engineering feats that gave rise to some of the greatest civilizations known to man. From Rome to the Pharaohs' Egypt, from Greece to Carthage, from the Aztecs to the Maya and more, this new program from the History Channel uses computer graphics to explore the architectural, political and cultural glory of the world's greatest empires.

programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: Every day, new information is discovered that helps us better understand how our Universe works. Some of this evidence solves mysteries dating back thousands of years. Some evidence offers new theories on how human civilization came into existence. In this season of The Universe: Ancient Mysteries Solved, we'll tackle mysteries such as an American Stonehenge built 500 years before Columbus, and how the Aztec Pyramids helped seal the downfall of the Mayan and Aztec empires. We'll also look at some of the Roman Empires' most iconic structures, and their connection to archeo-astronomy.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: U-Boat Wargamers
programme.desc: WATU faces a crucial encounter for ONS.5 in the Battle of the Atlantic. Dönitz unleashes the new torpedo that targets the escort ships. Roberts and Laidlaw must counteract the new weapon and recapture the waves.

programme.title: Battles BC
programme.desc: Step back in time and revisit some of the most brutal battles that took place before Christ. Recreated with stunning technology, we reveal these violent conflicts like never before, examining the soldiers, strategies and weapons deployed by the powerful legions. From Hannibal's clashes with Rome to Alexander the Great's pursuits throughout India, these conflicts have had a resounding impact on our history and with these reconstructions you will see the ferocious aspects of war in antiquity.

programme.title: Life After People
programme.desc: This unique documentary series explores what the planet would look like if all human life diappeared. With comment and opinion coming from scientists, engineers and other experts, this show speculates on how a lack of human intervention would impact on the environment and the other animal species. The show does not provide any explanation as to why humans have vanished from the face of the Earth but does surmise that human infrastructure is still present along with pets and domesticated livestock. Each episode explores what would happen to specific structures such as skyscrapers, bridges and dams or details the impact on human remains, artefacts and other objects. Some real-life abandoned locations are discussed and the show also uses CGI dramatisations to depict how the situation would look after one day, one week, one year, 10 years, 15 years, 25 years, 50 years, 100 years, 200 years, etc.

programme.title: Ждём в гости
programme.desc: В Кахетии есть очень интересное село Сабуе, где бок о бок живут грузины, осетины и кистины-чеченцы. Вместе они работают и вместе проводят праздники, готовя свои национальные блюда. Места здесь настолько живописные, что многие из них решили завести свои небольшие хозяйства, ориентированные на туристический потенциал края. Тем более, этот уголок Грузии богат и памятниками древней архитектуры и историческими местами.

programme.title: Два с половиной человека
programme.desc: Закоренелый холостяк Чарли, постоянно опасающийся за свою свободу, и его брат Алан, недавно разошедшийся с женой, живут под одной крышей. Чарли только и делает, что заводит любовные интрижки, а Алан всеми силами пытается от него не отстать. В свободное от амурных приключений время братья воспитывают десятилетнего сынишку Алана Джейка.

programme.title: Два с половиной человека
programme.desc: Закоренелый холостяк Чарли, постоянно опасающийся за свою свободу, и его брат Алан, недавно разошедшийся с женой, живут под одной крышей. programme.title: Горько-соленое море любви
programme.desc: Татьяна Гордеева работает массажисткой в районной поликлинике. Её сын Саша часто болеет и врач рекомендует свозить его к морю. А после того как муж Тани Валера неожиданно уходит от неё к другой женщине, прихватив из дома всё, что можно, она понимает, что поездка на юг необходима и ей самой — прийти в себя после пережитой обиды. В Турции Татьяна знакомится с импозантным владельцем отеля Акифом и постоялицей Любой — охотницей за богатыми женихами, которая тут же набивается ей в подруги. Но вскоре случается трагедия: Саша падает со скалы и попадает в больницу. Денег на лечение сына у Тани нет. Тогда Акиф делает Татьяне необычное предложение: стать сиделкой для его матери — вздорной и своевольной женщины Эдже, у которой никто из прислуги не продержался дольше недели…

programme.title: Ждём в гости
programme.desc: Регион Самцхе-Джавахети часто называют "грузинской Сибирью". Здесь зимой бывают сильные морозы. Это довольно суровый край, который резко отличается от других уголков Грузии, что сказывается на условиях жизни, быте и даже кухне местных жителей. А еще это родина грузинских сортов пшенницы. Зрители посетят фестиваль хлеба в городе Ахалцихе, который проходил на территории старинной крепости "Рабат", узнают, как готовят месхетинский сыр "Тенили" и почему блюдо "Церо-хинкали" так популярно у детей.

programme.title: Нарисуй меня счастливой
programme.desc: Люба выросла в детдоме, рано вышла замуж и также рано овдовела. Её муж вёл разгульную жизнь — пил, играл в карты и в итоге погиб в драке. Люба была вынуждена браться за любую работу, чтобы обеспечить взрослую дочь Леру и властную свекровь Анну Борисовну. Теперь, несмотря на свой художественный талант, Люба работает маляром. На ней держится весь дом, но семья совсем не ценит её усилия. На Любу обращает внимание Антон Павлович — хозяин дома, где она делает ремонт. А вскоре за Любой начинает ухаживать приезжий электрик Самир. Однако дочь и свекровь делают всё, чтобы помешать её счастью. Когда Люба осознаёт, что родным нужны от неё только деньги, она решает уйти из дома…

programme.title: Госпожа Фазилет и ее дочери
programme.desc: Госпожа Фазилет после того, как потеряла мужа, одна воспитывает двух дочек. Вся жизнь Фазилет прошла в сожалениях, поэтому теперь ее вкладом в будущее стала младшая дочь Эдже. Но самым большим препятствием на пути матери является старшая дочь Хазан, которая несмотря на свою изысканную красоту ведет себя по-мальчишески и не ладит с матерью. Семья Эймен богата, могущественна, у них особняк на берегу Босфора, и однажды их пути пересекаются с Фазилет и ее дочерьми. Богатство Эймен даже превосходит мечты Фазилет. После знакомства с ними изменится не только жизнь Эдже, но и Хазан, которая влюбится в Синана Эймена, избалованного сына семьи.

programme.title: Провинциальный детектив
programme.desc: Заведующая городской библиотекой Татьяна Дашкова и медсестра Ольга Брянцева живут в небольшом очаровательном городке с древней историей и дружат с детства. Образованность, начитанность и неиссякаемый интерес к жизни Татьяны, в сочетании с практичностью, находчивостью и живостью ума Ольги дают удивительные результаты. Их тандем способен разобраться в самых запутанных ситуациях и выяснить истинные мотивы любого преступления, которых случается немало в этом, кажущемся спокойным, городке. Главное — внимание к мелочам и деталям, а также хорошее знание детективной литературы. Ведь героиням во всех делах помогают Шерлок Холмс, Отец Браун и другие известные детективы из произведений классической литературы.

programme.title: Главное
programme.desc: Ежедневная информационная программа Настоящего времени.

programme.title: Пять минут тишины. Возвращение
programme.desc: Инструктор туристической секции ведет в поход подростков, среди которых оказывается дочь Петрова, Маша. Ночью недалеко от разбитого палаточного лагеря педагог случайно замечает медведя и, желая обезопасить детей, выманивает его подальше от расположения. Сам мужчина оказывается в опасной ловушке. Борис вместе с Линой отправляются кататься верхом. Внезапно девушка падает с лошади и теряет сознание. Грек мчится в больницу, волнуясь о невесте и будущем ребенке. Вскоре спасатель узнает неприятную новость…

programme.title: Голубоглазый японец
programme.desc: Две сестры воссоединяются спустя 42 года разлуки, чтобы узнать историю своего легендарного отца. Виктор Старухин был беженцем из России, который преодолел нищету, ксенофобию и Вторую мировую войну, чтобы стать первой звездой бейсбола в Японии.

programme.title: Лицом к событию
programme.desc: Лидер в той или иной сфере общественной жизни - человек известный и информированный - под перекрестным огнем вопросов ведущих программы Михаила Соколова и Елены Рыковцевой.

programme.title: Голое влечение
programme.desc: Скандальный цикл передач, в которых люди находят потенциальных спутников жизни, обнаженные тела которых им показывают. Затем они должны будут сами раздеться и сделать выбор.

programme.title: Хор
programme.desc: Выступление Хора в Останкино проходит с триумфом. Впервые в истории \"Песни Года\", их просят спеть на бис. На Юру обрушивается всесоюзная слава. Концерты Хора расписаны на год вперед. Юрину школу осаждают журналисты, все мечтают с ним дружить. Увидев Ларису с Андреем, Кеша рассказывает отцу-дипломату о мамином романе и вынуждает ее расстаться с возлюбленным. Кузнечик, увидев по телевизору выступление Хора с песней, которую должен был петь, не выдерживает… Юра \"проваливает\" экзамен по сольфеджио и его отчисляют из Хора.

programme.title: Голубоглазый японец
programme.desc: Две сестры воссоединяются спустя 42 года разлуки, чтобы узнать историю своего легендарного отца. Виктор Старухин был беженцем из России, который преодолел нищету, ксенофобию и Вторую мировую войну, чтобы стать первой звездой бейсбола в Японии.

programme.title: CNN Newsroom

CNN has developed a lot since its founding in 1980 by American media proprietor Ted Turner as a 24 hour cable news channel. programme.title: The Imperial Presidency: A Fareed Zakaria Special
Fareed Zakaria GPS
programme.desc: Weekly public affairs show hosted by an American journalist, political scientist, and author Fareed Zakaria. The show is broadcasted on CNN every Sunday in many countries of the world. The "GPS" in the show's title stands for "Global Public Square," a reference to the show's focus on international issues and foreign affairs. The guests of the show's one-on-one interviews and roundtable discussions are most prominent figures in the world of global politics, economy and global decision-makers and influencers.

programme.title: African Voices
programme.desc: Shining a spotlight on Africa's most influential and inspiring talents through in-depth, authentic conversations. Hosted by Larry Madowo.

programme.title: Marketplace Asia

Follow the top business stories that influence and shape the Asian continent. programme.title: Marketplace Africa
programme.desc: Unique access to the latest African market information, with a look at events and developments that impact its business world. programme.title: Connecting Africa
programme.desc: The African continent is going through a big transformation and this CNN magazine presents the entrepreneurs, companies and projects that are working hard to modernise it and make its economic integration possible. Hosted by Eleni Giokos, the episodes bring stories about the fast growing industry, network communication, cross-border trade and increasing trading routes, air connectivity, logistics infrastructure, small businesses and more.

programme.title: Inside Africa
programme.desc: Each week, Inside Africa documentary series on CNN highlights the unique diversity of mysterious Africa, its numerous cultures and religions, peoples, art, music, cuisine, travel and literature, its one-of-a-kind flora and fauna. Watch the interviews with people from various spheres of life and find out more surprising facts about this continent: how it fights for conservation of rare animals, who the new figures in fashion and design are, what the new educational programs for children look like. Everything what Africa is filled with and lives for is in this series.

With expert analysis from CNN's correspondents and analysis from the show's panel, Erin Burnett OutFront dissects the stories of the day, leaving no stone unturned. Burnett, a former financial analyst for Goldman Sachs, uses her forthright approach to engage interviewees in honest discussion.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Gumball Darwin and Carrie team up to convince their fellow students that the school is haunted. At Halloween show and tell the class isn't buying Gumball's story about Gargaroth The Devourer until Carrie fakes a terrifying haunting. The kids convince the school to hire them as ghost exterminators and take their payment in Halloween candy. But when it turns out Gargaroth is real suddenly Gumball is expected to be the town's saviour.

programme.title: Lamput
programme.desc: Fugitive Lamput ends up in a seedy dive by the waterfront. It happens when you're on the run. These thugs sure know how to have fun, though; people come from far and wide to be creamed at arm wrestling by gigantic Mr Moustache. It's a jumpin' scene - until those two dorks from the Lab walk in, and start kicking up a stink about the new extremely orange trophy that's up for grabs. The Boss (apparently an old bikie at heart) is more than up for the arm wrestling challenge. It's the bicep-off of the decade, with Lamput as the prize.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Gumball is walking in the same direction as Hot Dog Guy and with each step it becomes increasingly awkward. Gumball is too busy singing about ketchup to notice he's about to bump into Hot Dog Guy. They manage to get through an awkward moment only to discover they're travelling in the same direction. Their journey becomes increasingly awkward until a delusional mall cop tries to arrest them and in the process allows them to finally go their separate ways…

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Elmore residents are going missing and the cause of these disappearances may be closer to home than Gumball and Darwin think. A breaking news report tells the Wattersons that their neighbour is among the several mysterious disappearances happening across Elmore. Their search for clues leads them to find a strange egg which they soon discover belongs to their own Evil Turtle. The family realise that it's their responsibility to track down their pet before she and her brood do more damage to the town.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Gumball and Darwin agree to do all of Tobias's chores in exchange for good points! Gumball and Darwin discover that Tobias is doing way better than them in an online game called Galatrek. Tobias admits he earns "good points" doing chores for his parents which he then exchanges for dollars to buy cool stuff for Galatrek. If Gumball and Darwin do Tobias' chores they can earn his "good points" and use them for Galatrek. Gumball and Darwin think they've hit the jackpot. But these "good points" may not be quite as good as Tobias claims...

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball

programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: Adventure Time
programme.desc: Adventure Time is an American fantasy animated television series that shows a 12-year-old boy Finn and his best friend, a wise 28-year-old (in dog years) dog Jake with magical powers living in Lands of Ooo in post-apocalyptic world. They lean on each other during good and bad times, trust each another with secrets and look to each other for advice. Finn likes to travel and save princesses from evil monsters in Lands of Ooo. Jake is more than his friend, he is his mentor, and his extraordinary skills help the boy to fight evil. Finn and Jake hang out with Princess Bubblegum, the sovereign of the Candy Kingdom, the fearsome Ice King, an ice wizard, Marceline the Vampire Queen, a 1000-year-old vampire and rock musician and many more.

Bucket List
programme.desc: Bucket List is a travel program entirely dedicated to Japan, a wonderful country with unique culture and traditions, volcanoes, cuisine, lifestyle, and amazing people. Paddy Doherty and Daniel Coll are active in the British and Irish media, visit Japan and experience various things in each region, while encountering challenges that make them confront their own phobias and fears. programme.title: City Breaks
programme.desc: City Breaks is a travel show that guides you through most astonishing cities of the world to show their rich history and culture and inspires you to explore everything a city has to offer on a city break, its cuisine, shopping spots, wonderful views, historical values. From picturesque old towns to modern young cities, City breaks has it all- Munich, Budapest, Samarkand, Madrid, Dubai and much more. Take a rest and take a city break, you won't regret a single second.

programme.title: Off the Grid
programme.desc: This exciting series takes you to some of the most unusual places all around the world. Join the presenters as they visit remote destinations that are not the typical choices for tourists. Off the Grid shows you the hidden and often overlooked places with all their treasures. Discover them through their culture, history and way of living. Explore the food, traditions and customs and meet the people of wonderful countries like Gabon, India, Ethiopia, Ireland and more.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: For many years passion for travelling has been bringing people to unexplored continents, countries and places to look into culture, history, food, nature and people. This kind of passion if the key point of Backpack, a travel show that opens new spots all over the world by a show host travelling solo with a backpack. So make yourself comfortable and enjoy visiting Serbia, Spain, Israel, India, Egypt and many more. Take a look at the historical past and modern life, find out about traditions, get to know tourism hotspots and treasures of nature, plan your future vacations with the help of show hosts' recommendations.

programme.title: NHL. Anaheim Ducks - Vegas Golden Knights
Jalgpall: Bundesliiga. VfB Stuttgart - Bayer Leverkusen
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: Jalgpall: Hispaania LaLiga. Real Madrid - Girona
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

Urmase (Sepo Seeman) juurde sisse sadanud Kersti (Piret Laurimaa) osutub üsna kentsaka käitumisega daamiks, kes põhjustab probleeme nii Urmasele kui Raivole (Peeter Oja). Vaid Rebekka (Merle Palmiste) tundub olevat lemmikajakirja kolumnisti näol endale uue sõbra leidnud. Omapärase lahenduse pakub siiski Viks (Andrus Vaarik). Naabrimehe rollis Märt Visnapuu.

programme.title: Kättemaksukontor
programme.desc: Killer võtab Aleksandriga ühendust, saades raha ja relva. Tiit ja Sander, olles veendunud, et Kõrbekoer on keegi juhuslik restoranikülastaja, arreteerivad mehe koos asitõendiga. Freya üritab sidet luua Kõrbekoera tütrega.

programme.title: Padjaklubi
programme.desc: Christian peab ootamatult ärireisile minema ja Laura kardab nüüd üksi jäädes Christiani eksnaise Meeri kättemaksu. Teo organiseerib Maria selja taga soolaleivapeo ja Maria on häiritud sellest, et Teo teda justkui oma elukaaslaseks peab. Maria ja Teo juures toimub siiski soolaleivapidu, mille ajal Teo kõik tüdrukud oma sarmiga võlub - kõik peale Maria, kes kinnitab, et nad elavad endiselt ainult mängult koos. Misha ja Kristina treilerielu saab ootamatu ja naljaka lõpu.

programme.title: Nurjatud tüdrukud
programme.desc: "Nurjatud tüdrukud" on musta huumori ja põnevusega vürtsitatud draamasari, mille tegevuspaigaks on raskestikasvatavate tüdrukute kinnine õppeasutus. Sinna saabub eraeluprobleemide käest põgenev kriminaalpsühholoog Markus Tamm, kes satub silmitsi uute ja eelmisest veelgi keerulisemate probleemidega. Markusega samal päeval saabub kooli uus õpilane Hanna, kes on peamine kahtlusalune tuntud ärimehe mõrvas.

programme.title: Varjudemaa
programme.desc: Tallinnas edukalt karjääri teinud Rita peab naasma Saaremaale, kus ootamatult suri tema isa. Rita ei ole 20 aastat kodukülas käinud. Teda ootavad seal umbusklikud kohalikud, tumedad minevikuvarjud ja jahmatav tõdemus, et isa surm võis olla mõrv. Rita otsustab asja uurima hakata ja see seab ta silmitsi seni tundmatu pettuse, vägivalla ja hirmuga.

programme.title: Kodu korda
programme.desc: Al investeerib kõik oma elu säästud saate lauamängu valmistamisse.

programme.title: Kodu keset linna
programme.desc: Käsikiri: 2003–2010 Kerttu Rakke, 2010– Mihkel Ulman 2010– Livia Ulman 2010– Andris Feldmanis Peaosades Martin Veinmann, Kleer Maibaum, Indrek Ojari jt Kodumaise sarja keskmes on Tallinnas elav perekond: pereisa Hannes, tema naine Helen ning nende väike poeg. Elu hakkab probleemseks minema siis, kui nende ukse taha saabub Liis - Hannese tütar tema eelmisest abielust. Intriige punuvad ka naabrid, tuttavad ja sugulased.

programme.title: Kodu keset linna

programme.title: Pöörased
programme.desc: Cutler ja Chaough valmistuvad firmas radikaalseid muutusi tegema. Sterling ja Draper külastavad Los Angeleses klienti. Pete on Joani peale vihane.

programme.title: Padjaklubi
programme.desc: Miša ja Kristina peavad metsast tagasi linna jõudma, Kristinal on samas vaja Miša abi, et dirigent Tristanile muljet avaldada ja Miša peab nüüd treilerijama tõttu oma bossiga maid jagama. Laura kutsub tüdrukud enda poole, sest kardab Meerit ja tüdrukud peavadki õhtut veetes ootamatu ohuga rinda pistma. Keegi luusib Laura maja ümber ja salapäraselt ukse taha ilmunud veinikorv võib olla mürgitatud. Naljakas paanika kulmineerub aga suure üllatusega!

programme.title: Kullakesed
programme.desc: Dorothy, Blanche, Rose ja Sophia on neli eakat vanadaami. Nende kõigi suurimaks ühiseks jooneks on nende abikaasad - kõik on kas surnud või lahutand. Neli vanamemme otsustavad kokku kolida, et vanaduspõlve hõlpsamaks ning huvitavamaks teha.Kuid samas pole mitte ühelgi neist kadunud ammune janu meeste järgi. Igaüks üritab endale pidevalt kaaslast leida ning vahest ka teiselt üle trumbata.

programme.title: Nurjatud tüdrukud
programme.desc: "Nurjatud tüdrukud" on musta huumori ja põnevusega vürtsitatud draamasari, mille tegevuspaigaks on raskestikasvatavate tüdrukute kinnine õppeasutus. programme.title: Kättemaksukontor
programme.desc: Ühes alevikus hakkavad inimesed saama paljastava sisuga anonüümkirju. Kui aga toimuma hakkavad mõrvad, pöördub üks naine abisaamiseks Kättemaksukontori poole. Lisaks tööalasele stressile ei suuda Freya ära otsustada kahe mehe vahel.

programme.title: Beverly Hills, 90210
programme.desc: Steve kutsub Brandoni enda Malibu rannamajja. Brendale korraldatakse hüvastijätupidu. Kelly naaseb Euroopast ilma Dylanita. Andrea külastab Gil Meyersit.

programme.title: Skandaal
programme.desc: Endine USA Presidendi meediasuhete konsultant Olivia Pope on nüüd kriisijuht, kes suudab lahendada kõik probleemid nii, et keegi ei teagi, et sellised probleemid olemas olid. Kuid ükskõik kui hoolas sa oled oma töös, võid samal ajal enda eraelus väga palju kahju teha. Igal nädalal seisavad Olivia ja ta meeskond silmitsi paljude probleemidega, mis vajavad lahendamist. Ning kui nad suudavad päästa teiste inimeste elusid, ei tähenda see seda, et nad suudavad parandada ka enda omi.

programme.title: Pöörased
programme.desc: Don üritab takistada Sylvia poja ajateenistusse saatmist. Peggyl on kodus rott. Don ja Ted lepivad ära. Petel tekib probleem ema uue lapsehoidjaga.

programme.title: Rannavalve
programme.desc: Kalamees meelitab uue vetelpäästja Megani ennast päästma, et teda siis rünnata. Kui mees ei jäta naist rahule, peab Mitch leidma võimaluse teda takistada. Shaunil on tööga seotud kriis ning Eddie viib ta romantilisele nädalalõpureisile, mis muutub peagi kirglikuks.

programme.title: Kälimehed
programme.desc: Kersti hakkab ühtäkki Urmast jõuliselt kamandama ja käsutama, tirib pesupoodi kaasa endale intiimesemeid valima ja käitub muidu imelikult. Raivol tekib kontraplaan võtta Kersti oma reklaamibüroosse tööle. Rebekka aga tuleb äärmiselt hoogsale ideele hakata kirjutama oma elulooraamatut. Mängivad Peeter Oja, Sepo Seeman, Merle Palmiste, Piret Laurimaa, Andrus Vaarik jt. Stsenarist Peep Pedmanson, tootja Ruut.

programme.title: Kired
programme.desc: Sarja peategelasteks on kaks abielupaari, kelle suhted muudab keeruliseks ühe paari naise ja teise paari mehe vahel puhkenud kirg. 1998. aastal TV3 eetris jooksma hakanud seriaali stsenaariumi autorid olid Aita Kivi, Juhan Habicht ja Stella K. Wadowsky, toimetaja Tiina Lokk, näitejuht Rein Oja, režissöörid Toomas Kirss ja Kalev Lepik. Peaosadesmängisid Merle Palmiste, Marika Vernik, Ita Ever, Märt Visnapuu ja Ivo Uukkivi. Produtsent oli Toomas Kirss.

programme.title: Surmarelv
programme.desc: Legendaarsetel "Surmarelva" filmidel põhinev veriväske action-komöödiasari toob taas kokku kinoajaloo vingeima detektiivide paari! Oma naist leinav endine eriüksuslane Martin Riggs (Clayne Crawford) ja pärast infarkti tööle naasev Roger Murtaugh (Damon Wayans) moodustavad üdini vastandliku, aga ometi ideaalselt toimiva tandemi. Nende koostöö algus on okkaline, sest ohjeldamatu Riggsi pea-ees-tulle-sööstmise suhtumine põrkub vaoshoitud Murtaugh arusaamadega. Esimese ühise juhtumi lõppedes mõistavad aga mõlemad, et on lisaks uuele paarimehele leidnud endale ka parima sõbra.

programme.title: Kurjuse kannul
programme.desc: FBI kõige kogenumatest uurijatest ning profileerijatest koostatud meeskond lahendab ränki kuritegusid, mis esmapilgul tunduvad väljapääsmatult keerukad. Meeskonna iga liige on oma valdkonna tipp ning üksteist täendades pole ükski kuritegu neile lahendamatu.

programme.title: Mõrvaennetajad
programme.desc: Avahooajal USAs laineid löönud põnevussari salapärasest miljardärist, kes värbab endale appi endise CIA agendi, et ühiselt ennetada New Yorki ähvardavaid ränki kuritegusid. Pururikas geenius Finch ("Teadmata kadunud" staar Michael Emerson) on välja töötanud arvutiprogrammi, mis suudab tuvastada potentsiaalse mõrvari või tema ohvri veel enne selle kuriteo reaalset toimumist. Endine eriagent Reese (Jim Caviezel), kes pärast isiklikku tragöödiat elab New Yorkis kodutuna, on nõus Fichiga kampa lööma ja aitab Finchil huvipakkuva isiku üles leida. Reese'i ülesandeks jääb ka tulevase tapja kahjutuks tegemine. Loomulikult peab tandem tegutsema ülima saladuskatte all, sest nende info ja tegevuse paljastamise tagajärjed oleksid katastroofilised.

programme.title: Hudson ja Rex
programme.desc: Varastatakse börsiguru varandus, mille uurimine viib Charlie ja Rexi väga ootamatu varga jälgedele.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Miami CSI meeskonda juhib pommiekspert Horatio Caine. Temaga koos teostavad uurimisi ballistik ja relvaekspert Calleigh Duquesne ja raamatukoi Tim Speedle, kes tunneb Miami tänavaid nagu oma taskuid. Lisaks aitavad neid DNA spetsialist Alexx Woods ja sukelduja Eric Delko. See viisik toob alati tõe kuritegude kohta päevavalgele.

programme.title: Monk
programme.desc: Kui üks dr Kroegeri patsient vastuvõtu ooteruumis koristaja tapab, süüdistab dr Kroeger selles ennast ning jääb pensionile. Dr Kroegeri abist sõltuv Monk otsustab lugu uurima hakata lootuses, et tapja motiivi leidmine tõestaks, et Kroeger poleks saanud mõrva ka parima tahtmise juures kuidagi ära hoida.

programme.desc: Avahooajal USAs laineid löönud põnevussari salapärasest miljardärist, kes värbab endale appi endise CIA agendi, et ühiselt ennetada New Yorki ähvardavaid ränki kuritegusid. Pururikas geenius Finch ("Teadmata kadunud" staar Michael Emerson) on välja töötanud arvutiprogrammi, mis suudab tuvastada potentsiaalse mõrvari või tema ohvri veel enne selle kuriteo reaalset toimumist. Endine eriagent Reese (Jim Caviezel), kes pärast isiklikku tragöödiat elab New Yorkis kodutuna, on nõus Fichiga kampa lööma ja aitab Finchil huvipakkuva isiku üles leida. Reese'i ülesandeks jääb ka tulevase tapja kahjutuks tegemine. Loomulikult peab tandem tegutsema ülima saladuskatte all, sest nende info ja tegevuse paljastamise tagajärjed oleksid katastroofilised.

programme.title: Soovimatud
programme.desc: 28 merehädast päästetud migrandi kruiisilaev Orrizonte pardale toomine paiskab laeval valitseva tasakaalu segamini.

programme.title: Kurjuse kannul
programme.desc: FBI kõige kogenumatest uurijatest ning profileerijatest koostatud meeskond lahendab ränki kuritegusid, mis esmapilgul tunduvad väljapääsmatult keerukad. Meeskonna iga liige on oma valdkonna tipp ning üksteist täendades pole ükski kuritegu neile lahendamatu.

programme.title: Stumptown
programme.desc: Kuulus telekohtunik palkab oma kadunud venna leidmiseks appi Dexi, kuid avastab peagi, et ta ei ole ainus, kes ta venda otsib. Hoffman palub Grey abi, et leida autoröövlid, kes ta silme all auto varastasid. Dex ei ole Anseli ootamatuks uudiseks valmis.

programme.title: CSI: Miami
programme.desc: Miami CSI meeskonda juhib pommiekspert Horatio Caine. Temaga koos teostavad uurimisi ballistik ja relvaekspert Calleigh Duquesne ja raamatukoi Tim Speedle, kes tunneb Miami tänavaid nagu oma taskuid. Lisaks aitavad neid DNA spetsialist Alexx Woods ja sukelduja Eric Delko. See viisik toob alati tõe kuritegude kohta päevavalgele.

programme.title: Chicago politseijaoskond
programme.desc: Teismeline tüdruk leitakse surnuna Olinsky sõbra pesapalluri kodust.

programme.title: Monk
programme.desc: Kapten Stottlemeyeri kadunuks jäänud poega Jaredit otsiv Monk satub otsaga rockkontserdile, kus tal tuleb hakata lahendama lavatöölise kummalist surmajuhtumit. Kahe juhtumi üheaegne uurimine osutub aga äärmiselt keeruliseks ning Monkil tuleb langetada raske valik.

programme.title: Troopiline kõu
programme.desc: Kamp näitlejaid läheb eemale argielust ja üritab the suure-eelarvelist filmi Vietnami sõjast, kuni neid kistakse päris sõjaseisukorda. Jeff "Fats" Portnoy(Jack Black) on ülekaaluline koomik, kes üritab lahti saada oma narkosõltuvusest samal ajal dzunglis uut filmi tehes; Kirk Lazarus (Robert Downey Jr.) on oma generatsiooni parim näitleja, kes on võitnud 4 Oscarit; Kevin Sandusky (Jay Baruchel) on tundmatu näitleja filmipaigas; Tud Speedman(Ben Stiller) on aga poputatud action-staar, kes tahab hakata "tõsiseks" näitlejaks. Nad peavad panema on võimed proovile, et pääseda sõjast ja seda muidugi väga humoorikalt.

programme.title: Uus algus
programme.desc: USA 2013 romantiline draama Lavastaja: John Carney Osades: Keira Knightley, Mark Ruffalo, Adam Levine Mis juhtub, kui üksikud inimesed kohtuvad ja teevad koos ilusat muusikat?Gretta (Keira Knightley) ja tema kauaaegne kallim Dave (Adam Levine) on keskkoolist saati koos olnud laulukirjutajad, kes kolivad New Yorki, kui mees saab lepingu suure plaadifirmaga. Aga värske kuulsuse ahvatlused viivad Dave'i peagi õigelt teelt kõrvale ning segaduses ja armastuses pettunud Gretta jääb üksi.Tema maailm muutub paremaks, kui põlualune plaadifirma produtsent Dan (Mark Ruffalo) East Village'is tema esinemise peale satub ja on silmapilkselt tema andest lummatud. Sellest juhuslikust kohtumisest võrsub võluv portree neid mõlemaid muutvast koostööst, mille taustaks on suvi New York City's.

programme.title: Suhete mänguväljak
programme.desc: Jalgpallurist südametemurdja satub saatuse tahtel laste jalgpallimeeskonna treeneriks. Sellest hetkest muutub jalgpalliplats tema hoolealuste ja nende veetlevate emade suhete mänguväljakuks.

programme.title: Käsna-Kalle Kantpüksi film
programme.desc: USA 2004 animafilm Lavastaja: Stephen Hillenburg Bikiini Põhjas on taas muresid küllaga. Keegi on ära röövinud kuningas Neptuni krooni ja paistab, et süüdlaseks on Käsna-Kalle Kantpüksi ülemus hr Krabi. Kuigi Käsna-Kallelt on võetud võimalus saada oma unelmate töö, ei hülga ta oma bossi ja asub koos parima sõbra Patrickuga ohtuderohkele teekonnale Merekarbilinna, et saada tagasi kroon ja päästa hr Krabi elu. FILM ON EESTI KEELES!

programme.title: Käsna-Kalle Kantpüks
programme.desc: USA 2015 animafilm Lavastaja: Paul Tibbitt, Mike Mitchell Osades(hääled):Margus Tabor (Käsna-Kalle), Veikko Täär (Plankton), Andrus Vaarik (Kalmer), Mart Toome (Härra Krabi), Jarmo Reha (Patrick), Aita Vaher (Sandy), Liia Kanemägi-Jõerand (Karen), Tõnu Oja (Burksihabe), Juss Haasma (Kyle). Maailma kuulsaim mere-elanikust selgrootu, Käsna-Kalle Kantpüks, tuleb vee alt välja meie maailma seiklema. Härra Krabi ja Planktoni vahelise tüli käigus läheb kaduma salajane burgeri valmistamise retsept ning kui Bikini Põhja elanikud ei saa enam oma armastatud burksi süüa, võtab maad kohutav kaos. Kõik peavad retsepti varasteks Käsna-Kallet ja Planktonit. Kaasosalistest tandem ehitab olukorra päästmiseks ajamasina, millega siirdutakse aega enne retsepti salapärast kadumist. Teel satutakse aga kõikvõimalikesse teistesse kummalistesse paikadesse, kus kohatakse nii naljakaid kui ka nalja mitte mõistvaid olendeid. Kes on tegelikult burksiretsepti röövel ja mida kangelased Bikini Põhja rahu taastamiseks tegema peavad, see selgub kuival maal.

programme.title: Nõiduslik lelupood
programme.desc: Ekstsentriline mänguasjapoe omanik soovib pensionile jääda ja palkab raamatupidaja. Häbelik noormees peab vormistama lelupoe ümber Molly-nimelise tütarlapse nimele, kes on kaotanud huvi elu vastu.

programme.title: Täitsa metsas!
programme.desc: Punamütsike, hunt, vanaema ja jahimees räägivad politseile nende kohtumise eellugu.

programme.title: Punamütsike kurjuse vastu
programme.desc: Eestikeelne animafilm! Punamütsike viibib parajasti salajasel eriagentide koolitusel, kui saabub kutse ülesandega uurida Hansu ja Grete ebatavalist kadumist. Ta satub tõelise kaose keskele ja ehk just selle pärast põrub ka oma kõrgtaseme eksamil. Kuid kallis Vanaema, Hunt ja ülejäänud "H.E.A." agendid on Punamütsikese nimel valmis ükskõik kelle vastu välja astuma, olgu selleks kas või Vanakuri ise.

programme.title: Üleni tuledes
programme.desc: Jõulukomöödia tele-esilinastus! Steve (Matthew Broderick) on tõeline jõulufanaatik, kelle elu on organiseeritud viimse kui pisidetailini ning kelle maja on alati jõulude ajal kõige uhkemini kaunistatud hoone kogu linnas. Tema uus naaber Buddy (Danny DeVito) on Steve'i täielik vastand: lärmakas ja lohakas tüüp, kellel on suured unistused ja plaanid, mis pole seni veel teostuda jõudnud. Mehe värskeim unistus tekitab naabrite vahel palju pingeid, sest Buddy tahab kaunistada oma maja jõulude ajaks nii võimsa valgus-show'ga, et see oleks näha ka kosmosest! Naabri auahne sebimine ajab Steve'i endast välja ning ta otsustab Buddy üle trumbata, maksku mis maksab! Selline arutu "võidurelvastumine" läheb mõlemale kalliks maksma…

programme.title: Kujuta ette
programme.desc: Edukat finantsanalüütikut ärritab tütre käitumine, kes klammerdub oma lemmikpleedi ja kujutletavate sõbrannade külge. Kuid nende nõuanded tõotavad tulu tuua.

programme.title: Eksnaiste klubi
programme.desc: Kolm lahutatud naist kohtuvad kolledžiaegse sõbranna matusel ja hakkavad hauduma kättemaksu meestele, kes on nad nooremate naiste pärast maha jätnud.

programme.title: Bumerang
programme.desc: Kui edukast tegevjuhist seelikuküti uus naisülemus on temast veel kõlvatum, avastab mees, et tema eluviis on tema enda vastu pöördunud.

programme.title: Õnnetooja Chuck
programme.desc: Charlie Loganil lasub juba koolipõlvest alates needus. Nüüdseks edukaks hambaarstiks saanud mees ei ole võimeline leidma tõelist armastust. Veelgi hullem, ühe endise pruudi pulmas saab ta teada, et viimne kui tüdruk, kes temaga maganud on, leidis kohe järgmisel kohtamisel oma elu õnne. Enne kui ta arugi saab, on Chucki kui "õnnetooja" maine levinud kulutulena ning teda piiravad lugematud õnneotsijad - seksikatest võõrastest kuni tema ülekaalulise sekretärini.

programme.title: The Dictator
programme.desc: Kangelaslik lugu diktaatorist, kes riskis oma eluga, et tema armastusega valitsetud riiki ei jõuaks kunagi demokraatia.

programme.title: Õudne film
programme.desc: USA 2000 õuduskomöödia Lavastaja: Keenen Ivory Wayans Osades: Shannon Elizabeth, Regina Hall, Jon Abrahams, Marlon Wayans, Shawn Wayans, Carmen Electra jpt. Kogu loo lükkab käima kauni abituriendi mõrv, keda maskis tapja alguses telefonitsi terroriseeris. See sündmus ehmatab ära tapetu teismelised klassikaaslased (keda mängivad loomulikult näitlejad vanuses 20-30!), kes kannavad nimesid nagu Buffy, Brenda, Drew. Kangelanna Cindy Campbell (Anna Faris) peab koos sõpradega kaitsma end nii maskis tapja kui ka üliagara kriminaalreporteri eest. Kas tuleb tuttav ette? Sellegipoolest on tegijatel varuks veel nii mõnigi roppnaljakas üllatus, mille puhul tundub uskumatu, et keegi midagi sellist üldse julgeb kinoekraanil näidata. "Õudne film" on häbitu paroodia, mille tegijad irvitavad paljude kassatükkide üle, kusjuures oma osa saavad nii "Matrix", "Kuues meel", "Tavalised kahtlusalused", "Blairi nõiafilm", "Karje" jt.

programme.desc: Heidi on väike söakas tüdruk, kes elab koos oma vanaisaga kõrgel Šveitsi mägedes. Ta leiab kiiresti ühise keele nii inimeste kui loomadega ja võidab oma rõõmsa ellusuhtumisega nende südamed. Heidi õpib austama teisi inimesi ja saab teda, kui oluline on omada häid sõpru, kes aitavad sind läbi eluraskuste.

programme.title: Hoodie
programme.desc: "Hoodie" on superkangelase lugu täiesti tavalisest poisist, kellel on erakordne parkuuri talent ja õiglustunne. Nüüd on ta juba kaks aastat harjutanud parkuurimist Soufianiga, Brüsseli parima jäljekütiga. Ta teeb seda salaja, sest tema ema, innukas politseinik, ei kiidaks seda iial heaks. Kui kolm naabruskonna last Flo, Basim ja Kenza avastavad Pieteri talendi ja motivatsiooni, ühinevad nad ootamatuks superkangelaste tiimiks nimega tiim Hoodie. Neid ühendab üks eesmärk - vabastada naabruskond ülekohtust.
